input.behavior_to_protect: After normalization, the domain must be lowercased while the local part stays exactly as supplied.

description: Write one regression scenario where an address has an uppercase domain 'User@EXAMPLE.COM'; after normalization the domain must be 'example.com' while the local part stays 'User'. The scenario must fail a mutant that lowercases the entire address.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
